about_missing.costs: No About page hurts E-E-A-T and stops LLMs from citing the brand as a source.
about_missing.hook_ctx: SERP click-through and LLM citation rate when there is no About page.
about_missing.label: No About page
about_missing.support: About pages are the strongest single signal LLMs use to decide who to quote.

canonical_missing.costs: Google may index the wrong URL variant and split link equity across duplicates.
canonical_missing.hook_ctx: authority leaked when there is no canonical tag.
canonical_missing.label: No canonical
canonical_missing.support: 25% of link equity lost when Google picks the wrong URL to rank.

canonical_not_self.costs: Incorrect canonicals point Google at the wrong page for the topic.
canonical_not_self.hook_ctx: risk of ranking the wrong URL when canonicals don't self-reference.
canonical_not_self.label: Wrong canonical
canonical_not_self.support: 100% de-indexing risk when the canonical points elsewhere.

cls_high.costs: Layout shift causes mis-clicks + bounce, and Google demotes pages with CLS above 0.25.
cls_high.hook_ctx: leads lost when layout shifts move buttons under the click.
cls_high.label: CLS high
cls_high.support: 14% higher bounce when CLS is above 0.25.

contact_missing.costs: No contact page kills the direct lead path and weakens E-E-A-T.
contact_missing.hook_ctx: SERP click-through and LLM citation rate when there is no clear contact or booking page.
contact_missing.label: No contact page
contact_missing.support: Google helpful content: contact info is a core E-E-A-T signal.

content_visibility.costs: Google indexes what Googlebot renders, not what the user's browser renders. Content hidden from the live-test doesn't count toward ranking.
content_visibility.hook_ctx: leads lost when Google's render pass misses the content the user actually sees.
content_visibility.label: Content Visibility (render gap)
content_visibility.support: Serve critical copy in the initial HTML or hydrate before Googlebot's render-queue timeout (~5 min on mobile).

crawl_budget_wasted.costs: Wasted crawl budget delays discovery of new money pages.
crawl_budget_wasted.hook_ctx: index efficiency wasted on redirect, error and noindex URLs.
crawl_budget_wasted.label: Crawl budget wasted

cta_missing.costs: Visitors arrive but there's nothing for them to do, so traffic doesn't turn into leads.
cta_missing.hook_ctx: more leads when pages get a clear CTA. Right now visitors have nothing to click.
cta_missing.label: No CTA
cta_missing.support: 35% conversion lift when a clear above-fold CTA is added.

dead_nav_links.costs: Dead nav links break the money-page crawl path and hurt UX.
dead_nav_links.hook_ctx: conversion path broken when primary-nav links point at '#' instead of a real page.
dead_nav_links.label: Dead nav link
dead_nav_links.support: Google Search Central: navigation links pass topical authority to key pages.

duplicate_homepage.costs: Duplicate homepage variants split link equity and confuse Google's canonical choice.
duplicate_homepage.hook_ctx: rank loss when /home and / serve identical content.
duplicate_homepage.label: Duplicate homepage

duplicate_page.costs: Duplicate pages split link equity so neither ranks well.
duplicate_page.hook_ctx: rank loss when two versions of the same page coexist.
duplicate_page.label: Duplicate page

error_404.costs: Dead links lose traffic and dilute site authority.
error_404.hook_ctx: authority lost through dead links and 404s.
error_404.support: 10-15% authority leak from dead internal links.

error_404_money.costs: Broken product, service, or checkout pages kill conversions and let Google demote the URL.
error_404_money.hook_ctx: leads lost when money pages 404. Visitors bounce, Google drops the URL.
error_404_money.label: 404 (money page)
error_404_money.support: 40% traffic drop on commercial URLs after they 404.

error_5xx.costs: Server errors block indexing and break the user experience.
error_5xx.hook_ctx: indexability on pages returning server errors.
error_5xx.label: 5xx
error_5xx.support: 100% of traffic lost while a page returns 5xx.

faceted_canonical_wrong.costs: ?product_cat= URLs canonicalising to a generic collection hide filtered pages from Google.
faceted_canonical_wrong.hook_ctx: ranking risk when faceted URLs canonicalise to the wrong parent.
faceted_canonical_wrong.label: Wrong faceted canonical

faq_missing.costs: You lose People-Also-Ask real estate to competitors who mark up their answers.
faq_missing.hook_ctx: click-through when FAQ answers show under your listing.
faq_missing.label: No FAQ
faq_missing.support: Google PAA carousel drives approx 5% CTR uplift on match; source: Semrush 2024 SERP study.

favicon_cms_default.costs: A CMS default favicon tells every searcher the site isn't maintained. In the mobile SERP it shows next to the title — your result looks like a template, competitors look like real businesses.
favicon_cms_default.hook_ctx: leads lost when your favicon is the WordPress/CMS default logo instead of your own brand mark.
favicon_cms_default.label: WordPress-logo favicon
favicon_cms_default.support: Replace with a square brand mark (≥96px) exported from your logo.

favicon_default.costs: Default favicons signal an unbranded, generic site in the tab and in Google search.
favicon_default.hook_ctx: SERP click-through when the favicon is the platform default.
favicon_default.label: Default favicon
favicon_default.support: Google 2019 SERP redesign: favicon shows next to every mobile organic result.

favicon_missing.costs: Favicons in tabs and SERP drive brand recall and repeat visits.
favicon_missing.hook_ctx: SERP click-through and repeat visits when tabs and search show no brand icon.
favicon_missing.label: No favicon
favicon_missing.support: Google 2019 SERP redesign: favicon shows next to every mobile organic result.

flat_architecture.costs: With no primary nav, users and Google can't reach service / product pages from the homepage — those pages don't rank and don't convert.
flat_architecture.hook_ctx: leads lost when the site has no top navigation to reach money pages in one click.
flat_architecture.label: Flat structure
flat_architecture.support: 2-3x more pages reach top-10 on sites with a clear top nav.

fragment_only_nav.costs: Fragment-only navigation gives Google one page to rank instead of many — Product, Reports, Integrations, How It Works all lose their own SERP.
fragment_only_nav.hook_ctx: ranking coverage when the whole product sits on one page and every nav item is a #fragment instead of a real URL.
fragment_only_nav.label: Fragment-only nav
fragment_only_nav.support: Distinct indexable pages per topic is the strongest predictor of long-tail search coverage.

h1_missing.costs: Missing H1s give Google no topic to rank the page for, directly hurting rankings and leads.
h1_missing.hook_ctx: more leads when key pages have a proper H1. Pages with no H1 give Google no topic to rank for.
h1_missing.label: No H1
h1_missing.support: 15% ranking lift on pages with a keyword-relevant H1.

h1_multiple.costs: Competing H1s blur which topic the page is about, and Google picks the weaker one.
h1_multiple.hook_ctx: ranking dilution when multiple H1s compete on one page.
h1_multiple.label: Competing H1s

h1_short.costs: Short H1s under-describe the page and weaken Google's ranking signal for it.
h1_short.hook_ctx: Google ranking impact when H1s are too short to describe the page.
h1_short.label: Short H1

high_carbon.costs: Heavy pages fail Core Web Vitals and lose mobile ranking.
high_carbon.hook_ctx: page weight vs the mobile median. Slow to load, slow to rank.
high_carbon.label: Heavy page

homepage_h1_whitespace.costs: Large whitespace runs in the homepage H1 read as unprofessional and weaken the topic signal.
homepage_h1_whitespace.hook_ctx: on-page relevance when the homepage H1 has broken layout.
homepage_h1_whitespace.label: H1 layout broken

homepage_images_broken.costs: Broken images increase first-visit bounce and cost image-search entries.
homepage_images_broken.hook_ctx: bounce and lost Google Image traffic when homepage images render as broken.
homepage_images_broken.label: Homepage images broken

homepage_media_broken.costs: A broken hero banner hurts engagement and bounce.
homepage_media_broken.hook_ctx: engagement lost when the homepage video / banner does not render.
homepage_media_broken.label: Homepage media broken

homepage_title_weak.costs: A weak homepage title costs Google's #1 on-page signal on the site's most-linked page.
homepage_title_weak.hook_ctx: ranking loss when the homepage title is just 'Home - Brand' with no keyword.
homepage_title_weak.label: Homepage title weak
homepage_title_weak.support: Moz on-page factors: title is the strongest on-page ranking signal.

hreflang_missing.costs: Wrong-language pages show up for wrong-country searchers.
hreflang_missing.hook_ctx: international traffic when Google can't map language variants.
hreflang_missing.label: No hreflang

http_www_redirect_missing.costs: Both variants resolving with 200 splits ranking signals across duplicate URLs.
http_www_redirect_missing.hook_ctx: ranking loss when http and non-canonical www variants don't 301 to the canonical host.
http_www_redirect_missing.label: No canonical redirect
http_www_redirect_missing.support: Google canonicalization docs: consolidate to a single canonical host.

hub_linking_weak.costs: Hero products get few contextual internal links, so Google can't tell what to rank.
hub_linking_weak.hook_ctx: rank loss on hero pages when there is no hub-to-sub-to-PDP link flow.
hub_linking_weak.label: Weak hub linking
hub_linking_weak.support: Google Search Central: internal links pass topical authority to key pages.

hub_subdomain.costs: A subdomain hub splits authority — the money site loses the topical strength the blog builds.
hub_subdomain.hook_ctx: domain authority when the content hub lives on a separate subdomain.
hub_subdomain.label: Hub on subdomain
hub_subdomain.support: Moving blog.example.com to example.com/blog concentrates PageRank on one domain.

image_large.costs: Oversized images dominate page weight and slow first paint.
image_large.hook_ctx: load speed when images ship at full resolution.
image_large.label: Oversized

lcp_high.costs: Slow load kills the click before the page loads, and Google pushes slow pages down on mobile.
lcp_high.hook_ctx: leads and rankings lost when LCP is above 4 seconds.
lcp_high.label: LCP > 4s
lcp_high.support: 53% of mobile visits leave a page taking over 3s.

lcp_medium.costs: Borderline speed puts you behind faster competitors in Google's mobile SERP.
lcp_medium.hook_ctx: leads and rankings when LCP sits between 2.5s and 4s.
lcp_medium.label: LCP 2.5-4s

low_inlinks.costs: Google under-values pages nothing else on the site links to.
low_inlinks.hook_ctx: crawl priority for pages with very few internal links.
low_inlinks.label: Few inlinks

meta_duplicate.costs: Duplicate descriptions weaken snippet relevance across pages.
meta_duplicate.label: Duplicate

meta_fragment.costs: Fragment meta descriptions leave the snippet essentially empty and Google auto-generates a poor one.
meta_fragment.hook_ctx: SERP CTR when the meta description is a 1-30 char stub.
meta_fragment.label: Fragment meta
meta_fragment.support: Portent CTR study: hand-written meta descriptions lift SERP CTR by 5.8%.

meta_long.costs: Over-length descriptions get cut mid-sentence, hurting click-through.
meta_long.hook_ctx: CTR loss from truncated descriptions in search.
meta_long.label: Too long
meta_long.support: 20% CTR drop when the meta description gets truncated.

meta_missing.costs: Google writes your snippet — and picks the wrong sentence. On a decision-heavy site, that snippet decides who trusts you enough to click.
meta_missing.hook_ctx: more leads with a meta description. You have none on the pages that matter.
meta_missing.label: Missing
meta_missing.support: 5.8% CTR uplift with a written meta description vs. Google auto-snippet.

meta_short.costs: Short descriptions under-use the snippet and lower click-through.
meta_short.hook_ctx: snippet space wasted on descriptions under 70 chars.
meta_short.label: Too short
meta_short.support: 15% snippet-space waste on descriptions under 70 chars.

nav_missing.costs: No top menu means Google (and users) can't reach the money pages in one click.
nav_missing.hook_ctx: crawl coverage without a persistent top navigation.
nav_missing.label: No top menu
nav_missing.support: Every page needs a stable primary nav for internal PageRank to flow.

near_duplicate.costs: Duplicate pages cannibalise each other — none of them ranks strongly.
near_duplicate.hook_ctx: traffic loss when Google collapses duplicate content into one URL.
near_duplicate.label: Near-duplicate

non_indexable.costs: Pages with noindex cannot rank and are invisible to organic traffic.
non_indexable.hook_ctx: chance to rank — noindex pages are invisible to Google.
non_indexable.label: Noindex

orphan_page.costs: Orphan pages are hard for Google to find and easy for users to miss.
orphan_page.hook_ctx: discoverability for orphan pages that no other page links to.
orphan_page.label: Orphan

pagination_no_rel.costs: Without pagination signals, page 2 competes with page 1 for the same query.
pagination_no_rel.label: No rel pagination

perf_low.costs: Poor performance is a direct Google mobile ranking signal — and users bounce before conversion.
perf_low.hook_ctx: leads and rankings when Lighthouse perf is under 50.
perf_low.label: Perf < 50
perf_low.support: 50% conversion drop when Lighthouse perf is under 50.

perf_moderate.costs: Passable is not competitive — the top-3 competitors all score 90+.
perf_moderate.hook_ctx: leads and rankings when performance sits in the 50-89 band.
perf_moderate.label: Perf 50-89

placeholder_urls.costs: Placeholder URLs (/21977-2/, /sample-page/, /uncategorized/) live in the sitemap and dilute topical authority.
placeholder_urls.hook_ctx: crawl efficiency drained by unedited WordPress auto-slugs.
placeholder_urls.label: Placeholder URL
placeholder_urls.support: Google crawl budget guide: keep low-value URLs out of the index.

render_blocked.costs: Blocked resources stop Google from seeing the full page, dropping rankings and leads.
render_blocked.hook_ctx: leads lost when critical resources are blocked from crawl.
render_blocked.label: Blocked resource
render_blocked.support: 50% ranking loss when critical resources are blocked from crawl.

render_blocking.costs: Render-blocking resources delay the first meaningful paint, hurting rankings and leads.
render_blocking.hook_ctx: leads lost when render-blocking scripts delay first paint.
render_blocking.label: Render blocking
render_blocking.support: 200-500ms LCP improvement when render-blocking scripts are removed.

render_error.costs: Rendering / JS errors mean affected pages may not be indexed and produce zero leads.
render_error.hook_ctx: chance of leads from pages Google can't render at all.
render_error.label: Render error
render_error.support: 0% chance of ranking on pages Google can't render.

render_js_dependent.costs: JS-dependent content is indexed slower — and sometimes not at all, so leads never arrive.
render_js_dependent.hook_ctx: leads lost when the page needs JS to become useful content.
render_js_dependent.label: JS-only
render_js_dependent.support: 35% ranking loss when content is JS-only.

robots_block.costs: A site-wide robots block prevents crawling and ranking entirely.
robots_block.hook_ctx: of the site is blocked from Google when robots.txt has Disallow: /.
robots_block.label: robots blocks site

robots_missing.costs: No robots.txt removes crawl control and hides the sitemap reference.
robots_missing.hook_ctx: SERP visibility risk when robots.txt is missing or empty.
robots_missing.label: No / empty robots
robots_missing.support: Google robots.txt spec: robots.txt should always be served, even if empty.

schema_article_missing.costs: Missing Article schema hides author, publish date and rich snippets in search and news.
schema_article_missing.hook_ctx: more leads from article pages when they ship Article / BlogPosting schema.
schema_article_missing.label: No Article schema
schema_article_missing.support: 20% more organic clicks on articles with Article schema.

schema_breadcrumb_missing.costs: Without BreadcrumbList, SERP shows raw URL instead of a readable hierarchy.
schema_breadcrumb_missing.hook_ctx: SERP CTR when product/category pages ship BreadcrumbList schema.
schema_breadcrumb_missing.label: No Breadcrumb schema

schema_local_missing.costs: Without LocalBusiness schema, Google may not attach your business to map pack results.
schema_local_missing.hook_ctx: more local visibility with LocalBusiness schema on the contact and location pages.
schema_local_missing.label: No LocalBusiness schema
schema_local_missing.support: 3x local pack visibility with LocalBusiness schema.

schema_organization_missing.costs: Without entity schema, Google and LLMs can't tie the site to a real business.
schema_organization_missing.hook_ctx: richer SERP results with Organization / LocalBusiness / WebSite schema on the homepage.
schema_organization_missing.label: No Organization schema
schema_organization_missing.support: 40% higher brand-panel show rate with Organization schema.

schema_product_missing.costs: Without schema on product/service pages, Google can't render rich results and LLMs miss key context.
schema_product_missing.hook_ctx: more leads on money pages with Product / Service / SoftwareApplication schema.
schema_product_missing.label: No product schema
schema_product_missing.support: 35% CTR uplift on money pages with Product / Service schema.

sitemap_missing.costs: No sitemap slows indexation and hides new pages from Google for weeks.
sitemap_missing.hook_ctx: leads lost when Google discovers pages 2x slower without a sitemap.
sitemap_missing.label: No sitemap
sitemap_missing.support: 2x slower indexation for new URLs without a sitemap.

spelling_grammar.costs: Errors in customer-facing copy read as inattention and cost the sale.
spelling_grammar.hook_ctx: conversion loss from copy with spelling or grammar issues.
spelling_grammar.label: Errors
spelling_grammar.support: Global Lingo B2B survey 2023: 59% of buyers won't purchase after grammar issues.

structured_data.costs: No schema anywhere on the site means no rich results on Google and no signal for LLMs like ChatGPT or Perplexity. Searchers pick someone else.
structured_data.hook_ctx: more leads with structured data. No page on your site ships any.
structured_data.label: No schema
structured_data.support: 30% more organic clicks on pages with rich results in the SERP.

tag_pages_indexable.costs: Low-value tag pages waste crawl budget and dilute topical authority.
tag_pages_indexable.hook_ctx: crawl budget and topical authority drained by indexable tag pages.
tag_pages_indexable.label: Tag pages indexable
tag_pages_indexable.support: Google crawl budget guide: keep low-value pages out of the index.

thin_content.costs: Money-decision pages don't earn enough trust to rank if they're thin, so they don't drive leads.
thin_content.hook_ctx: more leads once thin pages get depth.
thin_content.label: Thin
thin_content.support: 54.4% of Google clicks go to pages in top-3.

title_all_caps.costs: All-caps titles look spammy in Google search results and drop click-through.
title_all_caps.hook_ctx: SERP CTR when the title tag is in shouting caps.
title_all_caps.label: ALL CAPS title
title_all_caps.support: Portent CTR study: sentence-case titles outperform all-caps by ~12%.

title_duplicate.costs: Duplicate titles confuse Google about which page to rank, so none of them rank well.
title_duplicate.hook_ctx: leads lost when Google collapses duplicate titles into one URL and hides the rest.
title_duplicate.label: Duplicate title
title_duplicate.support: 50% CTR gap between unique titles and shared titles across a site.

title_duplicate_sitewide.costs: Duplicate homepage-title on every page pushes all inner pages out of non-branded search — the site rides on one URL only.
title_duplicate_sitewide.hook_ctx: leads lost when every page shares the homepage title and only one URL can rank.
title_duplicate_sitewide.label: Sitewide Duplicate Titles
title_duplicate_sitewide.support: Only 1 of N pages wins the SERP when every page shares one title.

title_long.costs: Truncated titles in search reduce click-through and rankings.
title_long.hook_ctx: CTR loss when titles get truncated in the SERP.
title_long.label: Truncated
title_long.support: Portent CTR study (2024): truncated titles lose about 3% CTR at same position.

title_missing.costs: Missing titles severely weaken relevance signals, rankings and leads.
title_missing.hook_ctx: leads lost when the title tag is missing.
title_missing.label: Missing title
title_missing.support: 35% ranking lift vs. pages with no title tag.

title_short.costs: Short titles under-describe the page and waste SERP space.
title_short.hook_ctx: SERP space wasted on titles under 30 chars.
title_short.label: Too short
title_short.support: Directional benchmark based on SERP-CTR studies.

title_stuffed.costs: Keyword stuffing looks spammy and can hurt rankings.
title_stuffed.hook_ctx: ranking risk from keyword-stuffed titles that Google flags as spam.
title_stuffed.label: Keyword stuffed
title_stuffed.support: Google spam policies flag keyword stuffing as a violation.

unoptimized_images.costs: Heavy images push LCP over the limit and hurt Core Web Vitals.
unoptimized_images.hook_ctx: load speed lost to unoptimised images.
unoptimized_images.label: Heavy images

url_long.costs: Long URLs are harder to share and look less clickable in the SERP.
url_long.hook_ctx: SERP click-through when URLs above 115 chars get truncated in results.
url_long.label: Long URL
url_long.support: Backlinko URL study: URLs over 115 chars underperform on CTR.

viewport_pinch_zoom_blocked.costs: Blocking pinch zoom fails Google's mobile-friendly test and hurts accessibility.
viewport_pinch_zoom_blocked.hook_ctx: mobile usability score when the viewport blocks pinch zoom.
viewport_pinch_zoom_blocked.label: Pinch zoom blocked
viewport_pinch_zoom_blocked.support: Google mobile-friendly test rejects pages that disable user scaling.

wwwredir_missing.costs: Both www and non-www resolving splits ranking signals.
wwwredir_missing.hook_ctx: ranking loss when www and non-www both resolve.
wwwredir_missing.label: www + non-www both live

wwwredir_temp.costs: Temporary redirects do not consolidate link equity to the canonical host.
wwwredir_temp.hook_ctx: link equity loss from 302 instead of 301 on the www redirect.
wwwredir_temp.label: 302 www redirect
wwwredir_temp.support: Google canonicalization docs: prefer 301 for permanent host consolidation.
